LEITURAS.MENSAGENS_COM_RESPOSTAS: The latest customer and team messages
LEITURAS.ULTIMA_MENSAGEM: The message that started the automation
LEITURAS.CONVERSA: Channel, inbox, labels and status of the conversation
LEITURAS.CONTATO: Contact name and fields (never email or phone)

CAMINHO.DICA: From 2 to 8 paths. When the conversation is unclear, the AI picks “None applies” instead of guessing.
CAMINHO.SEM_LETRA: The path name needs at least one letter.
CAMINHO.RESERVADO: “None” is already the path for when nothing applies. Pick another name.
CAMINHO.REPETIDO: There is already a path with this name.

CAMPO.DICA: The AI fills in only what is written in the conversation. If it is not there, the field stays empty and the history says so.

DESTINOS.SUGESTAO: Leave as a suggestion for the team to review

CUSTO.MEDIA: About {custo} per run, on your account AI key.
CUSTO.PRIMEIRA: The cost shows up after the first run.

TESTAR.DICA: Runs on up to 3 conversations you can see and shows what it would do. Sends and saves nothing. Uses your account AI key.

AVISO.GATILHO_SEM_CONVERSA: This automation starts from a card. The test uses the most recent conversations you can see.
AVISO.NENHUMA_ENTRARIA: No recent conversation would enter this automation right now. The test uses the most recent ones you can see.

MOTIVOS.NADA_PARA_LER: There was nothing for the AI to read in this conversation. The AI was not called.
MOTIVOS.IA_INDISPONIVEL: The AI did not answer in time. Try again.
MOTIVOS.CHAVE_RECUSADA: The AI provider refused the account key. Check the key in integrations.
MOTIVOS.OUTRO: The AI could not answer for this conversation.
